The present revisional application has been preferred praying for quashing of the proceedings in connection with Rabindra Sarovar Police Station Case No. 58 of 2025 dated 28.05.2025 under Sections 120B/420/467/406/468/471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 pending before the Court of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Alipore, South 24 Parganas (corresponding to CGR Case No.

sentences.text:
The petitioners' case is that on the self-same allegation a prior complaint had been lodged by the complainant before the Assistant Commissioner of Police, Tulinj, Vasai Virar Police Commissionerate and on due inquiry, the Enquiring Officer being the Sub-Inspector of Police,
Assistant Commissioner, Tulinj Department submitted a report along with supporting documents praying for the file to be closed on due inquiry.
The complainant in the said case vide a written complaint dated 03.01.2025 had filed a complaint on the self-same allegation before the Mumbai Police.
The enquiry report in the said case file was submitted on 13.02.2025.

On the said case file being closed, the complainant has now filed the present case by filing a written complaint dated 27.05.2025 on the self-same allegation, on which the Mumbai Police on enquiry had filed the case.
The present case being Rabindra Sarobar Police Station Case no. 58 of 2025 has been registered on the complaint dated 27.05.2025.
It appears that the complaint contains on the self- same allegation on the basis of which the Mumbai Police on enquiry closed the case file.

Some of the findings of the Mumbai Police are relevant to be reproduced hereinunder:
"3.
The defendant Aditya Birla, a director of the company, has said that the current share certificate submitted by the applicant is fake and forged.

Regarding the forgery,
he said that the Distinctive No. (S) important on the certificate and it is not mentioned on it, but as per the company records, that number was mentioned on the Cosmic Crf Limited & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 10 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27699278/
1 share certificate submitted to the company by Raja Saha for transfer.
6.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As per the provisions of the of the Companies Act, each share in the company must have a separate number and stamp duty must be paid as per the provisions of the Stamp Act, and accordingly, there is documentary evidence that the shareholder has taken that number of shares.
However, it is seen that it is missing on applicant's share certificate.
This corroborates the company's claim that they are fake.

7. Overall, on prima facie inquiry, it is not proved that the current share certificates of the applicant are legal and they did not derive any financial benefit from their alleged share sale transaction.

Therefore, since it does not reflect that their shares were sold with their fake signature, we are closing the inquiry into the said application and keeping a provision for advising to file a case in the relevant court as per the provisions of the Companies Act for the validity of their share certificates.

However,
after perusing the said inquiry report and the supporting documents attached therewith, the matter is submitted for file to be closed."

Considering the said facts, the proceedings in connection with Rabindra Sarovar Police Station Case No. 58 of 2025 dated 28.05.2025 under Sections 120B/420/467/406/468/471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 pending before the Court of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Alipore, South 24 Parganas (corresponding to CGR Case No. 1674 of 2025) be stayed till 28 th July, 2025 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.

entities.text: Chief Judicial Magistrate, Alipore, South 24 Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioners are directed to effect service upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the next date of hearing.
Let the matter be placed before the Regular Bench in due course.
( Shampa Dutt (Paul), J. )
